camel_example: aliyun dts ModifySubscription --region cn-hangzhou --SubscriptionDataTypeDDL true --ModifyType update_dbList --DtsJobId 'boss6pn1w******' --ResourceGroupId 'rg-acfmzawhxxc****' --SubscriptionDataTypeDML true --RegionId 'cn-hangzhou' --DtsInstanceId 'dtsboss6pn1w******' --DbList '{"dtstest":{"name":"dtstest","all":true}}' --Reserved '{"publicSbeSwitch":"off"}'
description_en: Modifies the subscription objects and data types of a DTS change tracking task
description_zh: 调用ModifySubscription接口修改DTS订阅任务的订阅对象及订阅数据的类型
kebab_example: aliyun dts modify-subscription --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --dts-instance-id 'dtsboss6pn1w******' --db-list '{"dtstest":{"name":"dtstest","all":true}}' --dts-job-id 'boss6pn1w******' --subscription-data-type-ddl true --subscription-data-type-dml true --resource-group-id 'rg-acfmzawhxxc****' --reserved '{"publicSbeSwitch":"off"}' --modify-type update_dbList --region cn-hangzhou
name: ModifySubscription

parameters.help_en: The region where the DTS instance resides. For more information, see https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/141033.html
parameters.name: region_id

parameters.help_en: The ID of the change tracking instance. You can call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/209702.html operation to query the instance ID
parameters.name: dts_instance_id

parameters.help_en:
The modified subscription objects. The value is a JSON string. For more information, see https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/209545.html.
The original DbList is overwritten by the new DbList. Make sure that the new DbList contains all the objects that you want to track. Otherwise, subscription objects may be lost. Proceed with caution.
To query the original subscription objects, you can call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/208925.html operation
parameters.help_zh:
修改后的订阅对象，格式为JSON串。详细定义，请参见https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/209545.html。
原DbList会被新传入的DbList覆盖，请确保新传入的DbList数据中包含所有需要订阅的对象，否则可能会导致订阅对象丢失，请谨慎修改。
原订阅对象，可调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/208925.html进行查询
parameters.name: db_list

parameters.help_en: The ID of the change tracking task. You can call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/209702.html operation to query the task ID
parameters.name: dts_job_id

parameters.help_en:
Specifies whether the modified task tracks DDL statements. Valid values:
true: Yes.
false: No
parameters.help_zh:
修改后任务是否订阅DDL类型的数据，取值：

true：是。
false：否
parameters.name: subscription_data_type_ddl

parameters.help_en:
Specifies whether the modified task tracks DML statements. Valid values:
true: Yes.
false: No
parameters.help_zh:
修改后任务是否订阅DML类型的数据，取值：
true：是。
false：否
parameters.name: subscription_data_type_dml

parameters.help_en: The ID of the resource group
parameters.name: resource_group_id

parameters.help_en: The extended configuration of the change tracking task. The value is a JSON object string. This parameter is used to update the extended configuration when ModifyType is set to update_reserved
parameters.help_zh: 订阅任务的扩展配置，格式为 JSON 对象字符串。当 ModifyType 为 update_reserved 时用于更新扩展配置
parameters.name: reserved

parameters.help_en: The modification type. A value of update_dbList indicates that the subscription objects are modified. A value of update_reserved indicates that the extended configuration of the change tracking task is updated
parameters.help_zh: 修改类型。update_dbList 表示修改订阅对象，update_reserved 表示更新订阅任务的扩展配置
parameters.name: modify_type
